Ryan Gallagher  
978-555-0198 | ryan.gallagher@fintechinnovators.com | Boston, MA  

A data-driven professional with a focus on scalable solutions for financial systems. Specializes in building analytical frameworks that balance precision and operational efficiency. Proven ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights across enterprise environments.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Senior Data Scientist*  
FinTech Innovators Inc. (2022–present)  
Led the development of predictive models for credit risk assessment, integrating real-time transaction data with historical behavioral patterns. Spearheaded the migration of legacy reporting systems to a cloud-native architecture, reducing query latency by 30% and enabling real-time dashboards for risk managers. Collaborated with product teams to design feature engineering pipelines, improving model accuracy by 12% in high-stakes fraud detection scenarios.  

*Data Scientist*  
Capital Analytics LLC (2021–2022)  
Architected a time-series forecasting system for liquidity management, leveraging SQL analytics and scikit-learn to predict cash flow fluctuations with 92% accuracy. Built a centralized data warehouse using Pandas and SQL, streamlining cross-departmental reporting and reducing manual data reconciliation efforts by 40%. Mentored junior analysts in best practices for data modeling and statistical validation.  

*Data Analyst*  
FinTech Startup Co. (2020–2021)  
Developed a Python-based tool for automated regulatory compliance checks, processing thousands of transactions daily to flag anomalies. Created dashboards using SQL queries and Python scripts to track KPIs for AML monitoring, improving audit readiness by 25%.  

**Projects**  
*Real-Time Fraud Detection System*  
Designed a scalable fraud detection pipeline using Apache Airflow for orchestration, Pandas for data preprocessing, and scikit-learn for model deployment. Integrated with existing transaction databases to reduce false positives by 15% while maintaining 98% detection rates.  

*Market Trend Analysis Platform*  
Built a time-series analysis tool to predict short-term market movements, combining SQL analytics with NumPy-based statistical methods. Enabled trading teams to make data-informed decisions, resulting in a 10% improvement in portfolio performance over six months.  

*Credit Scoring Model Optimization*  
Reengineered an existing credit scoring model using advanced feature selection techniques and NumPy-based matrix operations, increasing approval rates by 8% without compromising risk thresholds.
